tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a line-numbered UTF-8 text file window, or attach a supported image or MP4/MOV video file as model-visible output.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search files with native ripgrep semantics. Results are confined by the current filesystem policy and emitted through tool output. Prefer this tool over shelling out to `rg`, `find`, or `grep -r` via powershell: it is policy-confined, output-bounded, and w...[truncated]

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a complete UTF-8 file admitted by the current filesystem policy. For a LARGE file, write a small first chunk here and then grow it with edit_file — one huge write can exceed a single model response and fail to send.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace one unique exact text match in a file admitted by the current filesystem policy. Also use this to GROW a large file in steps: match its current last line(s) and replace them with those line(s) plus more, so you never send one huge write_file that c...[truncated]

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read a bounded line window from one local Markdown memory file. Use this when you need live memory content; reads never write to memory.

tools.name: add_memory
tools.description: Add Markdown content to local memory: creates the file when it is missing, appends to the end when it already exists, and does not overwrite existing content. Use edit_memory for exact replacements.

tools.name: edit_memory
tools.description: Replace one exact string in local Markdown memory. The edit fails unless old_str appears exactly once; use add_memory to append new content.

tools.name: work_stop
tools.description: Stop one runtime-owned work item by canonical Work ID, such as a launched workflow run or other long-running background work.

tools.name: work_list
tools.description: List current background work in this session, including Monitor, Bash, Workflow and native subagents. Use this to recover a lost canonical work_id for work_stop. Returns up to 100 items; pass next_after_work_id as after_work_id for the next page. stop_requ...[truncated]

tools.name: powershell
tools.description: Run a Windows PowerShell command. By default commands are executed by powershell.exe, so use PowerShell syntax and environment variables such as `$env:NAME`, not Bash or cmd.exe syntax. By default the runtime waits at most 10 seconds in the foreground; for...[truncated]

tools.name: powershell_input
tools.description: Send input to, resize, or terminate a running PowerShell PTY session using the internal session_id handle returned by powershell — use it when a live interactive process needs input. Do not use it to poll a backgrounded command for completion: the final re...[truncated]

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Monitor is for repeated events from one long-running source, never for a single completion: for one-shot work such as "tell me when the build is done", run the command once with powershell and report. Sources: a shell command (each stdout line is an event;...[truncated]

tools.name: cron_create
tools.description: Schedule a prompt to run later — once, or on a repeating 5-field local-time cron. Recurring jobs auto-expire after 7 days unless permanent is true. Returns a job id you can pass to cron_delete.

tools.name: cron_delete
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled job by its id (from cron_create/cron_list).

tools.name: cron_list
tools.description: List all scheduled jobs for this session, with their cadence and next fire time.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the active session goal and progress. Returns {"goal": null} when no goal is set. Do not call to orient yourself, to check whether a goal exists, or on a greeting — only call when you are already working on an explicit goal and need its current state.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Start a session goal only when requested. Fails if this session already has an unfinished goal; the failure message names the way out.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Mark the active goal complete or blocked. Use complete only when no required work remains.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report active goal progress. percent_complete=100 is equivalent to update_goal(status="complete").

tools.name: request_user_input
tools.description: Request user input for one to three short structured questions and wait for the response. Argument rules: for single-select, omit selection or use selection={mode:single}; the single-select shape has no numeric bounds. For multi-select, use selection={mode...[truncated]

tools.name: subagent_spawn

tools.name: subagent_status
tools.description: Read subagent status from the replayable owner registry.

tools.name: subagent_send_message
tools.description: Queue a message for a running child. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.

tools.name: subagent_wait
tools.description: Wait for a child result. timeout_ms defaults to 30000 ms and accepts 10000-300000. timeout or would_park leaves the child running. Finished results arrive automatically when your session is idle. Use subagent_cancel to stop the child. Pass the spawn-return...[truncated]

tools.name: subagent_read_result
tools.description: Read a bounded result envelope and artifact refs. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.

tools.name: subagent_cancel
tools.description: Request child cancellation. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Read one available SKILL.md body as a tool result.

tools.name: snooze_reminder
tools.description: Temporarily suppress matching async reminder notifications.

tools.name: write_todos
